concerns: The cited articles show use and intelligibility but do not establish frequency or Malaysia-wide prevalence.
The Malaysian report mainly uses “komputer riba,” so it provides limited evidence for standalone “komputer.”
result.rationale: In the audited Indonesian and Malaysian contexts, “komputer” refers to a computing device and matches the intended English sense of “computer.” “PC,” “laptop,” and “komputer riba” specify device types or contexts; the evidence does not indicate a conflicting meaning, register, or regional restriction.
